card.name: The word opposite and its relatives
card.fires_on: The word opposite, and forms like oppos- (opposing, opposed, opposites) or contrary, plus the word of right after opposite. It appears in general prose about reversed or conflicting things.

modes.label: opposite itself
modes.description: The word opposite or a stem such as oppos- is read, often in the phrase the opposite of.

modes.label: of after opposite
modes.description: The word of that follows opposite and leads into what is being reversed.
modes.example: was exactly the opposite<< of>> what he’d believed for years.

modes.label: related opposing words
modes.description: Words like opposing, opposed or contrary that mark conflicting ideas or effects.
modes.example: due to<< opposing>> effects on dopamine.

card.writes: It pushes toward words about contradiction, opposition and the contrary, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It lights up when text talks about something being the opposite of or in conflict with something else.
